sqlite.name: exercise_sensor_triggers
sqlite.sql:
CREATE TABLE exercise_sensor_triggers (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	session_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	station_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	telemetry_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_class VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	ingress_identity VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	ingress_transport VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	registry_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	credential_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	measured_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	received_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	processed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	water_depth_cm FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	previous_tier VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	current_tier VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_exercise_trigger_tier UNIQUE (session_id, station_id, current_tier), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_exercise_trigger_telemetry UNIQUE (session_id, telemetry_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_exercise_trigger_previous CHECK (previous_tier IN ('NORMAL','ADVISORY','WARNING','EVACUATE')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_exercise_trigger_current CHECK (current_tier IN ('ADVISORY','WARNING','EVACUATE')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_exercise_trigger_upward CHECK (CASE current_tier WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN 0 WHEN 'ADVISORY' THEN 1 WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 2 WHEN 'EVACUATE' THEN 3 END > CASE previous_tier WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN 0 WHEN 'ADVISORY' THEN 1 WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 2 WHEN 'EVACUATE' THEN 3 END), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_exercise_trigger_reason CHECK (reason = 'observed_tier_increase'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_exercise_trigger_status CHECK (status IN ('DELIVERIES_CREATED','NO_RECIPIENTS','SEND_LIMIT')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_exercise_trigger_source CHECK (source_class = 'physical_device'), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES exercise_sessions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(station_id) REFERENCES stations (station_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(telemetry_id) REFERENCES telemetry (id)
)

sqlite.name: exercise_station_arms
sqlite.sql:
CREATE TABLE exercise_station_arms (
	session_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	station_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	armed_by INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	armed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	baseline_tier VARCHAR(10), 
	baseline_telemetry_id INTEGER, 
	previous_tier VARCHAR(10), 
	cursor_telemetry_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	disarmed_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (session_id, station_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_exercise_arm_tier CHECK (previous_tier IS NULL OR previous_tier IN ('NORMAL','ADVISORY','WARNING','EVACUATE')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_exercise_arm_baseline CHECK (baseline_tier IS NULL OR baseline_tier IN ('NORMAL','ADVISORY','WARNING','EVACUATE')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES exercise_sessions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(station_id) REFERENCES stations (station_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(armed_by) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(baseline_telemetry_id) REFERENCES telemetry (id)
)

sqlite.name: exercise_sensor_deliveries
sqlite.sql:
CREATE TABLE exercise_sensor_deliveries (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	trigger_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	session_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	device_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	device_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	message_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	outcome VARCHAR(40), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	attempted_at DATETIME, 
	completed_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_exercise_sensor_delivery UNIQUE (trigger_id, device_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_exercise_sensor_type CHECK (message_type = 'EXERCISE_TEST'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_exercise_sensor_state CHECK (state IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING','TESTED','SENT','REJECTED','SUPPRESSED','UNKNOWN')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_exercise_sensor_single_attempt CHECK (attempts >= 0 AND attempts <= 1), 
	FOREIGN KEY(trigger_id) REFERENCES exercise_sensor_triggers (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES exercise_sessions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES notification_devices (id), 
	UNIQUE (idempotency_key)
)
